using Xunit;

namespace Demo.Tests;

public class CalculatorTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Add_ReturnsSum()
    {
        var result = new Calculator().Add(2, 3);
        Assert.Equal(5, result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Add_DoesNotThrow()
    {
        var result = new Calculator().Add(2, 3);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(1)]
    [InlineData(2)]
    public void Square_Runs(int x)
    {
        new Calculator().Square(x);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Divide_ByZero_Throws() =>
        Assert.Throws<DivideByZeroException>(() => new Calculator().Divide(1, 0));

    [Fact]
    public void Empty() { }

    [Fact]
    public void UsesFluent()
    {
        new Calculator().Add(1, 1).Should().Be(2);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void UsesHelper()
    {
        AssertValid(new Calculator());
    }

    [Fact(Skip = "flaky")]
    public void Skipped()
    {
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BraceInString_NoAssert()
    {
        var s = "{ not a block } http://example.com";
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task<int> AsyncGeneric_NoAssert()
    {
        return await Task.FromResult(1); // Assert.Equal in a comment does not count
    }

    private static void AssertValid(Calculator c) => Assert.NotNull(c);
}
